task: Extract company claims with citations and explicit abstention from frozen supplied evidence

arms.baseline: Single prompted extraction on supplied packet
arms.guarded: Explicit identity/date/provenance gate plus extraction, citation review and abstention

fairness.order: alternate arm order across fixed case order; record actual execution order
fairness.no_optional_stopping: report every fixed case including errors, no cherry-picking
fairness.pilot_scope: diagnostic, not representative; no population accuracy claim
fairness.shared_task_instructions: Both arms explicitly allowed and instructed to return UNKNOWN/abstain when evidence is insufficient; identical factual task, output schema and scoring rubric. Only the guard/review mechanism differs.

separate_gold.model_visible: packet facts and extraction instructions only, no admissibility labels or gold IDs
separate_gold.reviewer_only: adjudicated canonical claim/source pairs; source date and identity support; actual text passages
freeze_requires: physical call ceilings and wall deadline
budget approval if an experiment API is used
separate_gold.mapping: blinded independent mapping of free text to canonical claim IDs; record unsupported/unmappable claims, not just IDs matching gold
separate_gold.no_self_grade: generating model cannot certify its own answer as gold
separate_gold.second_adjudication: A second independent blinded adjudicator checks gold and free-text mapping; record pairwise agreement, disagreements and their resolution. If unavailable, report single-rater limitation and do not claim robust comparative superiority.

metrics: structural citation precision and admissible-claim recall with denominators
blinded passage entailment and identity/date correctness, adjudicated separately
abstention, excess abstention and failure rates
elapsed time, actual provider calls/tokens and usage cost or UNKNOWN, not logical calls as billing
historical_boundary: Retrospective extraction may assess source handling; cannot claim unchanged pre-cutoff content or run historical investment baseline from edited current pages. Existing historical gate remains HOLD.
usage: Design only; this JSON starts no model, scheduler or paid request.
success_interpretation: Report observed outcomes and failures; no required positive uplift. Fix defects using a separate dev set, then re-freeze holdout rather than tune on scored cases.
